entries.description: Ubau Uarati rúhamali hafiñe tuagu Garada to
entries.subject: Ubau Uarati

spans.text: Subúsewati luagu, sun lan fulasu le áundarubai tidaun Ubau Uarati rúhamali hafiñe tuagu Garada to, mamai tichiga inébehabu hawagu idúheñu fulásurugu, ayánuha luagu le yubai lun gürigia, ru tugia me úarani lun wügüritabu würi ubauwagu; afiñewati luagu lawánsera lan me sun ubau lugundu hawiwanda me gürigia lidan ibágari richati;
